title: Weak convergence of restrictions to sublevel sets (Helly selection, P6)
statement: Let U ⊆ ℝ^P be open, X_j ⇀ X in D_k(U), W ⊆ U open with sup_j M_W(X_j) < ∞, and φ : ℝ^P → ℝ continuous on U. Then there are a strictly increasing ψ : ℕ → ℕ and a countable E ⊆ ℝ such that for every s ∉ E and all restrictions R_j of X_{ψ(j)} and R of X to {x ∈ U : φ(x) < s}: (A) R_j(ω) → R(ω) for every test form ω with tsupport ω ⊆ W; (B) if {x ∈ U : φ(x) ≤ s} ⊆ K for some compact K ⊆ W, then R_j ⇀ R.
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ (Xj : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U k) (X : GeometricCurrentOn U k) (W : Set (Eucl P)) (φ : Eucl P → ℝ), WeaklyConvergesOn Xj X → IsOpen W → W ⊆ U → (⨆ j, (Xj j).massOn W) < ∞ → ContinuousOn φ U → ∃ (ψ : ℕ → ℕ) (E : Set ℝ), StrictMono ψ ∧ E.Countable ∧ ∀ s ∉ E, ∀ (Rj : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U k) (R : GeometricCurrentOn U k), (∀ j, IsRestriction (Xj (ψ j)) {x | x ∈ U ∧ φ x < s} (Rj j)) → IsRestriction X {x | x ∈ U ∧ φ x < s} R → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U k, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) k) ⊆ W → Tendsto (fun j => Rj j ω) atTop (𝓝 (R ω))) ∧ (∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ W → {x | x ∈ U ∧ φ x ≤ s} ⊆ K → WeaklyConvergesOn Rj R)
